A great quick weeknight dinner is **sheet-pan chicken fajitas**: toss sliced chicken breast, bell peppers, and onions with olive oil, chili powder, cumin, and lime juice; spread on a baking sheet and roast at 425 °F for 18–20 minutes. Serve in warm tortillas with salsa, avocado, and a dollop of Greek yogurt.
